Your visit, your privacy

Privacy policy.

How this information website handles data and external services.

Browsing this website

This version has no accounts, contact forms, ordering system, analytics scripts, advertising trackers, or site-set cookies. Menu search and category filtering run in your browser and are not sent to a server by the website code.

Technical requests

Your browser requests pages, images, styles, and scripts from the server hosting the website. A future hosting provider may process technical request information such as IP addresses and user-agent details. Hosting arrangements and retention practices must be confirmed before public launch.

Maps and phone links

The Google Maps embed loads only when you select “Load Google Map”. Loading it sends a request to Google, which may process your IP address and browser information and apply its own policies. Opening the Google Maps listing also takes you to Google. Phone links open your device’s calling application; no call is placed automatically by this website.

External services

External links and embedded content operate under their providers’ privacy practices. The café must review this policy again if forms, analytics, accounts, ordering, or other data collection are added.

Questions

For questions related to this website, call Bahattar Cafe at 982-0347351. A dedicated privacy contact has not been supplied.
